blocks.text: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is a global public health concern that affects millions of people and places a significant burden on healthcare systems. In the Philippines, CKD remains an important health challenge, highlighting the need for greater awareness, timely diagnosis, and access to appropriate treatment. CKD often goes undetected in its early stages because noticeable symptoms may be absent. In some people, it progresses to Stage 5 CKD, also known as end-stage renal disease (ESRD), when the kidneys can no longer adequately perform their essential functions.
